16.en: Inquisitor Raud’s investigation into Eskender Thracius has led her to a terrible truth: there is a definitive traitor in the Conclave. Eskender Thracius, however, has one card yet to play that may cover his escape…

26.en: In attendance at the fifth Conclave are: @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek}, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn}, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst}, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud}, and

30.en: (@UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}). @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}’ continued absence without communication has become a concern among the Inquisitors.

38.en: If characters or other operatives returned the daemonhost from @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.wHl3ZP7wM7OQvSLC]{Jotungarth} to @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis} (@UUID[.1EujWPAAI3xsXmIk#strife-iii-c-the-ghost-of-luna]{Strife III-C: The Ghost of Luna}, they learn it was subsequently claimed by @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} and moved to her chambers in Mare Cinis.

42.en: @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} may confide in the characters that she finds @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Raud}’s handling of daemons deplorable; keeping them contained as daemonhosts only serves to anchor their corruption in realspace — a criticism she also held of her mentor, the late Inquisitor Lord Drake. She claims that members of the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#ordo-malleus]{Ordo Malleus} often believe they have much firmer control over daemonkind than in reality. She encourages characters to inform her of any of

46.en: activities they learn of if daemonhosts are involved.

50.en: Characters may notice that @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Kai Varol} and @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} have gathered larger retinues than usual. Aside from the usual @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5rrnycKS5mMDjQJc]{Acolytes} in both retinues,

54.en: forces include a trio of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5a6Q3NRdPonZjiGr]{Death Cult Assassins}, who appear armed with weapons that do not match any Imperial STC. Characters who have interacted with @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} technology (such as in @UUID[.qMGtMcmwPnXnwPds#strife-i-a-the-void-stalker]{Strife I-A: The Void Stalker}) may recognise similarities to the xenos design.

72.en: The revelation of a traitor in the Conclave’s midst has everyone place their hands on their weapons. Tensions rise in the Conclave hall, putting a hold on further proceedings until the traitor can be dealt with.

80.en: @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} reveals to the Conclave the results of her investigation into @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} — through interrogation, observation, and missions undergone by her spy network — she has learned that

84.en: yet lives under one of numerous false identities, each maintained through extensive use of polymorphine.

88.en: She declares that his capture is vital. @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Raud} lists the false identities @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} operates under, ending with an accusation that

104.en: , or rather, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}, reveals the truth of these allegations but argues that his loyalty to the Inquisition is absolute. In turn, he reveals that the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl} has captured @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}, a situation he seeks to leverage (see @UUID[.HAzjoFV6pghpy0ou#strife-iv-b-the-lost-recongregator]{Strife V-B: An Inquisitor Compromised}.

112.en: The assembled Inquisitors call a vote on whether @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} is declared

116.en: or whether such decisions should be delayed until @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} is secured. The characters may discuss this vote with their Patron, and the players' choice should be reflected in the final decision).

136.en: With Alis Raud’s revelations out in the open and the Inquisitors present having picked a side, the fate of Eskender Thracius must be dealt with.

142.en: @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} will not be taken without a struggle. If he is declared

146.en: , a battle erupts in the Conclave hall.

150.en: makes a fighting retreat to his section of @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis} under covering fire from his @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5rrnycKS5mMDjQJc]{Acolytes}, armed with @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} weaponry. His quarters have been rigged with automated and servitor-controlled defences in anticipation of the day his cover is blown, including an emergency launch bay. From there, he escapes on a Valkyrie and commandeers an Imperial Fleet voidship in orbit around the moon. His acolytes are swiftly defeated following his departure, but the characters, the Inquisitors, and their retinues may have been badly wounded by the traps

158.en: If @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} is left to continue as part of the Macharian Inquisition, the characters' Patron suggests uncovering the depths of

162.en: heresy is a worthwhile goal. Their Patron seeks irrefutable leverage over the Radical Inquisitor, believing it is only a matter of time before

166.en: must be taken down. In this, the characters pursue the clues below but know that

170.en: is still lurking within the Macharian Inquisition, so they must tread carefully.

174.en: Clues left behind by @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} point characters to his false identities. These leads may be pursued through the contacts he made through each still-active alias:

186.en: ): Records indicate a base of operations for this identity on @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.nLrpWOo3BjHLB0FG]{Proteus Secundus} in the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.d0lv2v4FkeIb43jj]{Drimor Subsector}. The Planetary Governor, the matriarch Gulya, hesitates to allow unauthorised access to an Inquisitorial laboratory. Inquisitors of the Ordo Xenos are held in particular reverence in the Proteus System after xenos meddling drove the inhabitants to war with one another.

196.en: Long-lost scion to the nobility of

198.en: @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.ZIDINp9DtgCCj1Mg]{Harjus}): House Karvonan of Harjus holds little record of Bayezid Karvonan, having appeared seemingly from nowhere to claim title and land. Taikos is under guard by House Karvonan troops, who will attempt to kill any interlopers. Highborn politicking is cutthroat enough that Bayezid’s guards will see the allegation that their employer is the alias of a heretical Inquisitor as an obvious lie — doubtless part of a plot by another noble.

214.en: @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.h6Z6Ia2q5RkRUlDG]{Rogue Trader Dynasty}): Characters involved with @UUID[.qMGtMcmwPnXnwPds#strife-i-a-the-void-stalker]{Strife I-A: The Void Stalker} may already have contacts in House Iaysus. The most recent sighting of Captain Selim Iaysus’ vessel was purportedly plying the outer reaches of the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.d0lv2v4FkeIb43jj]{Drimor Subsector}, where it is currently docked to a voidstation above a feral world. Characters attempting to board the vessel to investigate its captain’s quarters may try to do so either under false identities or wielding Inquisitorial authority.

218.en: Each of these leads reveals another of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}’s many bases of operation. Investigating them may reveal information on his current whereabouts, the depths of heretical research on @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} technologies that

222.en: has engaged in, as well as stockpiles of Aeldari weaponry. If nothing else, securing them robs the Radical Inquisitor of another hiding place.

230.en: If characters pursue all known leads and return with information that may lead to @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}’ whereabouts, their Patron gains +1 Legitimacy. However, before they can act on this information to pursue

234.en: , a more significant problem arises from the Herald’s Howl (see @UUID[.4j86iM1J3kqqpOGg]{Conclave VI},). If the characters do not pursue

238.en: , @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} undertakes this investigation, gaining +1 Legitimacy and gathering information that may be vital for

264.en: Eskender Thracius has prepared a gambit to delay the Conclave from declaring him

268.en: , staying their hands for enough time to allow his escape. He has lured Konstan Serranus into a trap, ransoming the Inquisitor’s life to secure his escape.

276.en: @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} may be able to distract the Conclave with the fate of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}. He uses the cover that the rescue operation provides to escape for the time being, slipping out of the hands of the Conclave. From this position,

280.en: moves to cover his tracks and plot new identities to continue what he perceives as his duties to the God-Emperor.

284.en: Shortly before the previous Conclave, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} orchestrated the capture of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}, who, acting on a tipoff from

288.en: , was taken prisoner while investigating a cell of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl}.

296.en: When the vote against @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} is suggested, he reveals that he knows the location of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus}’ imprisonment.

304.en: He claims to also have been investigating the same cell, from which he gave the tipoff to @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus}, and is willing to orchestrate

316.en: If the Conclave accepts his bargain, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} asks for a cell of acolytes to be deployed to @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.VeiDfnkV55kTAkRw]{Kallastin}, in the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.4LYxCIJ2ansZ5wFk]{Andosk Subsector} — he will guide them remotely to secure the Inquisitor’s release.

330.en: The party departs for Kallastin to retrieve Serranus. They soon become embroiled in a planetary takeover, and more of the Howl's machinations are revealed.

342.en: @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} makes contact with the characters before their deployment — she has ties to the Planetary Governor, and can arrange military support on the surface. However, this is offered with the stipulation that characters and their Patron support her motions in future Conclaves.

346.en: On @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.VeiDfnkV55kTAkRw]{Kallastin}, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} makes contact with the characters. They learn that the recently appointed Planetary Governor Phytian de Kallastin has increased the planet’s industrial output considerably, although many of the residents of industrial habs note an increase in mutations among them as a result of excess industrial byproducts, overworked schedules, and lax safety protocols.

350.en: In reality, the heightened production has been used by the planet’s sect of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl} as cover for a population boom, allowing @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cultists} to spread through the populace of the planet’s industrial underclass unnoticed; characters who have faced these cultists before will recognise both their mutations, and the insurmountable threat their numbers pose to Kallastin. Given the cover that the heightened production has provided them, characters may suspect the cult has the support of the Planetary Governor.

354.en: @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus} is imprisoned in the Cathedral of the Star Children, a disused subterranean manufactorum that serves as a high temple of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}, replete with ornate star maps resembling the one found on @UUID[.qMGtMcmwPnXnwPds#strife-i-c-the-fate-of-the-lucanus]{Calvus Station}. His imprisonment is overseen by a circle of five psykers, who are debating what should be done with him once they squeeze every vermillion-level secret out of him. Their plans range from using the Inquisitor as a bargaining chip to attempting to merge Genestealer genetics with his own — thereby welcoming him into the fold as an asset with which to infiltrate the Inquisition and deflect their investigations.

358.en: Characters attempting to recover @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} find that the Cathedral is lightly defended, considering its importance, suggesting that the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cultists} are not expecting an attack.

362.en: There is little initial resistance to attempts to rescue @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus}, but forces muster and converge swiftly upon the Cathedral once word spreads that it is under attack. The @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cults'} forces are practically innumerable, forcing characters into a fighting retreat despite

366.en: ’ misgivings about leaving the xenos-corrupted heretics alive. If any psykers survive the initial attack, they order the cultists to prioritise slaying

378.en: Rescuing @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} grants the characters’ Patron +1 Legitimacy and the staunch support of the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#ordo-xenos]{Ordo Xenos} Inquisitor. If informed of the events at the Conclave,

382.en: deepens his hatred for @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}, both for setting him up to be captured, and his willingness to work alongside xenos to achieve his aims.

386.en: Attempting the rescue of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus} separates the Conclave for long enough that @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} is able to make his escape before a vote can be called to declare him

394.en: If the Party and their Patron pursue @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} instead (@UUID[.HAzjoFV6pghpy0ou#strife-v-a-excommunicate-traitoris]{Strife V-A}), @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} leads the operation to recover @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}. She recovers Serranus without bloodshed, negotiating with the cultists and offering them future support in exchange for the prisoner. On the surface, she believes that the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl }should be allowed to continue its work, drawing the Hive Fleet away from Segmentum Solar — sacrificing the Macharian Sector instead to buy Holy Terra more time.

408.en: With @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}’ treachery revealed, the Conclave’s decision has halted one heresy but allowed another to prosper. If @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus} returns alive, he immediately moves to take the reins of pursuing

412.en: , having already been in pursuit of one of his false identities. The @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}, however, will soon prove an obstacle to any standing Inquisitorial plans
